scenes.heading: Setting clear boundaries around what you will and won't do

sents.d: Setting clear boundaries around what you will and won't do
A written boundaries document prevents the most common trust breakdowns in this work.

Before taking on a client, it's worth putting together a simple written boundaries document covering what you will and won't say or offer on the creator's behalf when messaging subscribers — this protects both the creator's brand and your own professional standards.

Revisiting and updating this document as you learn a creator's specific preferences keeps the working relationship aligned, rather than assuming your default approach matches what every creator wants.
Being willing to turn down a client whose expectations conflict with your own boundaries, even when the money is good, protects your reputation and long-term ability to do this work sustainably.

take: Agree boundaries in writing and keep them updated.
